title: Tenma Saki — Ready To Take It All On〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Ready To Take It All On（4★）

rows.Line: CD Shop

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is...!
“The Miku Collaboration Album!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's great, Ichi!
I'm glad they still had some limited-edition ones in stock!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too! We were so busy getting for our solo show that I completely forgot to reserve a copy. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to get one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You really have amazing luck when it comes to these things, Ichika. Remember how you got the last copy of that other CD?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What if it's because they're Miku CDs?
They might've been waiting for you to come pick them up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That's a nice thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll take this up front.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪ See you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, while we wait, wanna check out what they have in the shelves in the back with all the indie bands?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Indie bands? That sounds fun♪
Let's go! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
All the artists on these shelves...
They're all indie bands?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this shop usually has a pretty good selection.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like... Oh, found it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! The artwork's so cool!
Do you like this band, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More that they're people I know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You know them?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I subbed in for them a couple times when they were down a bassist, but I heard they found one and made their debut a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, they're more experienced than us, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In terms of being pros, yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pros...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay. You weren't gone long.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm gonna buy this one if you guys don't mind waiting a bit...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You spaced out for a second there. Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, um... No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're really gonna go pro soon, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We still have our contract to discuss, but if things go well, yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mind still hasn't quite caught up yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Mine neither...
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In the not-so-distant future, we might start seeing our own CDs on this store's shelves...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This isn't a dream, right?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We really get to keep playing music together... As pros...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey...! A STANDOUT CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. They're being featured as a one of the hottest indie bands out there right now. I guess they are just that famous.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If Shiho joins them, she could actually make it and debut as a pro...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if she starts drifting away from us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I felt so sad that time, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The four of us finally made it to this point...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I hope we get to keep playing music together and have our songs heard by lots of people!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki, you seem so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just imagining what it might be like when they make a big display for Leo/need♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A display just for us? I think you're getting ahead of yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's important to visualize these things, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They said on TV that visualization leads to success!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't that just for professional athletes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What are you...? Oh yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
